pages.text: “Pure white bell-shaped flowers conceal potent toxins—beneath the sweetness lies an uncertain fate.”$(br2)Lily of the Valley Tea is a mysterious and dangerous drink made from dried lily of the valley petals. The tea has a rare purple hue and a deceptively sweet taste. Drinking it grants a temporary Haste effect but also carries a chance of poisoning the traveler.

$(br2)$(br)Lily of the Valley Tea is simple to prepare—$(br)just blend dried lily of the valley petals with sugar to create this risky yet powerful beverage.$(br)It is best used before battle, offering a brief but strong advantage, though caution is advised regarding its side effects.

Upon drinking Lily of the Valley Tea, travelers gain a Haste effect, temporarily increasing attack and mining speed, but there is also a chance of being poisoned.$(br)This high-risk tea is best suited for bold adventurers.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
